messages:
Alice: Quick sync — we need to lock the audit-event glossary + RBAC mapping changes before the RBAC rollout tomorrow. Sharing constraints and a proposed plan.
Ben: Are we doing a hard rename or aliasing for consumer-facing event names? Lots of customers parse event_name currently.
Alice: We should avoid a hard cut. Plan: dual-write v1 and v2 for 14 days, include `schema_version` and a `canonical_name` field. Translation table in-between.
Diego: How does this interact with KMS/audit linkage? Our KMS logs reference `key_id` but downstream correlators join on `event_name` + `actor.id`. Any change may break existing dashboards.
Claire: Proposal for canonical naming: use dotted nouns then verbs — `resource.action` (e.g., `workspace.member.invite`) so events group naturally. v1->v2 mapping example: `member.invited` -> `workspace.member.invite`.
Erin: Tests: we need consumer contract tests, an integration test that replays real events, and a schema linter that rejects unnamed enums. Also add e2e that validates KMS correlation (key_id present + non-null actor.id).
Bob: Legal note — customer-facing examples in the docs must match what we ship. If we dual-write, ensure docs show both versions and a migration note for SOC2 auditors.
Alice: Example payload for v2 (to share with SDK/docs):
```json
{"event_name":"workspace.member.invite","schema_version":"v2","timestamp":"2026-03-19T16:22:33Z","actor":{"id":"u-9f3","email":"alice@example.com"},"target":{"type":"workspace","id":"ws-42"},"metadata":{"method":"console"}}
```
Diego: Regarding KMS: ensure `encryption.key_id` stays in `metadata` and we add `kms.rotation_id` when rotation happens so downstream can join on stable ids. Also ensure PII redaction rules still apply.
Claire: Migration checklist draft: 1) add `schema_version` to producers, 2) dual-write codepath + feature flag, 3) deploy schema linter and validation lambda, 4) run replay job to confirm parity, 5) enable v2-only after 14 days and announce.
Erin: For replay job, we should sample both high-frequency API routes and admin routes. Add a failure-mode: if translation fails, emit `audit.translation_failed` with reason for diagnostics (do not leak PII).
infra-bot: deploy-preview created for branch `audit-schema/v2-mappings` — preview URL: https://ci.internal.redwood/audit-schema/v2/preview (expires in 48h) :rocket:
Ben: Consumers: add a compatibility header `X-Audit-Schema-Version` on the event stream so SDKs can auto-detect. Also we should provide a CLI migration tool that rewrites archived logs.
Alice: Owners: Claire (naming + mapping), Diego (KMS + correlation), Erin (tests + replay), Ben (consumer compatibility + SDKs), Bob (compliance sign-off). I'll open PRs with the mapping CSV and the linter rules.
Claire: Quick mapping sample (CSV rows):
old_name,new_name,notes
member.invited,workspace.member.invite,adds workspace context
access.revoked,resource.access.revoke,normalize verb to noun+verb
api.key.created,api.key.create,align with resource.action pattern

Diego: One open Q — for delegated actor scenarios (service-on-behalf-of-user) should we normalize `actor.type` to `user|service|delegated` or keep raw? I vote normalized enumerations.
Alice: Agreed — normalized enums + documented allowed values. Also add `actor.auth_flow` for delegated flows.
Erin: I'll add fuzz tests for enum variants and a regression alert if schema drift detected.
Bob: Please include a short blurb for customers explaining the migration and a link to the translation map. Compliance needs that for change logs.
Alice: OK — action items: Claire to push mapping CSV + canonical name doc by EOD, Diego to update KMS correlation spec + sample join queries, Erin to wire up replay and linter, Ben to sketch SDK compatibility header, Bob to draft customer note. Ping me once PRs are up and I'll coordinate the rollout timeline. :white_check_mark:
